name: Florensia Triacetate
original_name: フローレシア・トリアセテート
source: The Triacetate family is from a lineage of heroes which have the blood of dragons flowing within their veins. Here, the young and inexperienced Florensia enters the Labyrinth to fulfill her destiny by slaying the new demon lord, Lucina Velvet Gurizani.
